purpose: Re-evaluate Taiho work-up after explicitly modeling the Branch-surviving carrier-air and deck-team cadre. Advance crew integration modestly without importing the historical 601st Air Group as 225 extra aircraft or hollowing out the four established fleet carriers.

branch_start_state.completion: Feb-1944 Branch completion; exact day not authoritative

historical_sanity_anchors: Historical Taiho commissioned 7 Mar 1944, ran trials through 19 Mar, embarked a 75-aircraft component (27 fighter, 30 D4Y, 18 B6N) on/after 24 Mar, departed the Inland Sea 28 Mar and reached Lingga 5 Apr.
Historical 601st Naval Air Group was formed 15 Feb as the division-level carrier air organization; it must not be counted as a new 225-aircraft stock on top of existing carrier groups.

branch_acceleration_mechanism.aircrew: Use surviving carrier-qualified fighter pilots, D4Y/B6N leaders, navigators/observers and rotated veterans as seed cadres so the Taiho component is mixed-experience rather than novice-heavy.
branch_acceleration_mechanism.deck_and_maintenance: Use instructors/experienced petty officers from the unusually large surviving carrier establishment and secondary carriers for landing-signal, deck-handling, ordnance and maintenance standardization.
branch_acceleration_mechanism.core_protection_rule: Seed Taiho primarily from rear/training/secondary-carrier and rotating cadre pools. Temporary first-line loans are limited and must not reduce the four-core 20-Mar ready band below its own ledger.
branch_acceleration_mechanism.net_effect: Compared with simply copying the historical commissioning-to-air-group interval, basic air-group/deck integration can advance several days to about one week; full five-carrier synchronization does not advance by the full hull-construction delta.

workup_curve.combat_credit: local CAP/ferry/deck qualification and emergency defensive use; no fleet synchronized strike credit
limited independent CAP/search/short strike training package; still not a fifth synchronized offensive deck
Emergency fleet accompaniment and local/limited independent combat are plausible. Do not merge into the four-core 150-184 synchronized package.

training_cost_09_20Mar.accounting_note: Included in the dated work-up bands.

next_gates.southward_release: Earliest rational release from home waters centered 1944-03-21..25 after fuel/escort and deck-team check; no need to force a 20-Mar departure.
next_gates.five_carrier_synchronized_strike_gate: 1944-04-10..20 centered; still requires at-sea integration with the four-core, not merely arrival at a southern anchorage
next_gates.30Apr_consistency: Compatible with existing B+ 30-Apr checkpoint; that checkpoint should mean a useful fifth carrier with remaining large-formation integration debt, not an immature hull.

aircraft_type_guard: Do not duplicate Kinsei-Zero allocations already booked to the four-core/shore system. Taiho fighter component is a mixed current-production pool unless a later subtype ledger assigns scarce aircraft explicitly.
601 historical organization may be used as a doctrine/TOE analogue only after subtracting aircraft and personnel already present in Branch carrier ledgers.
